visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair tied back, wearing a black zip-up hoodie over a black tank top and white trousers, is being interviewed in an outdoor semi-covered area. She smiles and speaks animatedly, gesturing with her hands. The background contains various household items and a moped. (2) A close-up shows a Republic of China National Identity Card being held up. The surname '机' is clearly visible. The ID photo matches the woman in the interview. (3) The woman continues talking while gesturing towards her chest. Large, stylized text '机' with phonetic symbols appears on the screen in a white box. (4) The scene shifts to a historical black and white photograph of a group of indigenous people (Siraya) sitting in front of a thatched-roof house. Text overlays provide historical context. (5) An image of an antique Chinese manuscript is displayed, followed by a satellite map of the Kaohsiung area. Red text labels for surnames like '力', '机', '月', and '毒' appear across the map. (6) Back to the interview, the woman points to her head and gestures while explaining her tribe's history. She appears cheerful and expressive. (7) The camera pans slightly to show a row of large white ceramic jars with handles stored against a wall under a metal roof. (8) The woman laughs heartily, covering her mouth, while the interviewer, a young man in a grey cap and white t-shirt, looks at the camera with a confused expression. A comedic zoom focuses on one of the ceramic jars.
